title: GTA 6's WAiNK App: Scan 100 Spots for a Trophy
short_title_options: What to scan with WAiNK in GTA 6 📱 #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description:
Your phone's WAiNK app in GTA 6 does more than check cars for trackers: scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures around Leonida, and 100 scans unlock a trophy and count toward 100%. The landmarks set alone has 31. No story spoilers.

Sources: PowerPyx, GameSpot, Game8, GMTreks.
pinned_comment: How many have you scanned so far? 👇
